invariants_checked: cli/main.go installs signal.NotifyContext for SIGINT/SIGTERM, flushes terminal error envelopes cleanly, maps cancelled contexts to Unix exit code 130, and never echoes raw credentials or host paths.
Zero legacy brand tokens or hardcoded secrets exist in the binary entry point.
cli/acceptance/doc.go documents the contract vs acceptance_e2e test tier split accurately without executable side effects or stale brand references.

Raw API passthrough rejects protocol-relative paths (//host), non-slash-prefixed paths, fragments (#), backslashes, dot traversal segments, and percent-encoded path separators/traversals (%2e%2e, %2f, %5c, %00) with input.invalid_argument before --dry-run, exit-10 confirmation, or network dispatch.
HTTP method tokens are validated per RFC 9110 before --dry-run and confirmation gates; DELETE is destructive-gated and PUT/PATCH are write-gated unless -y is supplied.

Request body reads (--input file/stdin) are bounded to 16 MiB, response bodies and --paginate accumulation are bounded to 64 MiB and 1000 pages, non-2xx body snippets are truncated and terminal-sanitized, and -F/--field NaN/Inf tokens serialize safely as strings instead of crashing json.Marshal.

findings.summary: genyee api allowed protocol-relative //host URLs, dot/percent-encoded traversal paths, and invalid HTTP method tokens through --dry-run and exit-10 confirmation (misclassifying SDK Raw rejections as retryable network.error), read --input and HTTP responses without size or page bounds, and failed json.Marshal on -F NaN/Inf.

invariants_checked: chat validates resolved --kb and optional --session IDs via cmdutil.ValidateResourceID before opening sessions or SSE streams.
Auto-created sessions guard against nil/empty CreateSession responses (server.session_create_failed) and terminal-sanitize session IDs written to stderr notices.

Buffered JSON and live text modes surface terminal SSE error frames (projector.TerminalError) as typed stream errors rather than ok=true, and JSON mode caps buffered events/bytes (8192 events / 16 MiB).

findings.summary: genyee chat did not validate --session/KB IDs via ValidateResourceID, panicked on nil CreateSession responses, lacked a buffered event/byte cap in JSON mode, and ignored terminal SSE error frames when transport returned nil.

invariants_checked: chunk delete, chunk list, and chunk view validate <chunk-id> and --doc resource IDs via cmdutil.ValidateResourceID before --dry-run, exit-10 confirmation, or SDK client construction.
chunk delete enforces exit-10 confirmation before constructing the SDK client so unapproved destructive calls fail with input.confirmation_required even without active credentials.
chunk list bounds --all-pages pagination, chunk view guards against nil SDK responses, and human text renderers sanitize untrusted chunk metadata and content against ANSI/OSC 52 terminal injection.

findings.summary: chunk subcommands omitted ValidateResourceID on <chunk-id> and --doc, called f.Client() before ConfirmDestructive on chunk delete, panicked on nil GetChunkByIDOnly responses, lacked an --all-pages safety bound, and wrote raw chunk content with potential OSC 52 sequences to stdout.

invariants_checked: config view inspects the 4-level profile/KB resolution chain purely locally without network calls or secret store reads.

URL userinfo credentials embedded in GENYEE_HOST or profile host strings (https://user:pass@host) are stripped before emitting JSON or text output, and text cells sanitize terminal escapes via format.DashIfEmpty.

findings.summary: config view echoed embedded URL userinfo credentials (user:password@host) from GENYEE_HOST or profile host settings in plaintext JSON and text output.

invariants_checked: All ID-addressed kb subcommands (view, update, delete, pin, unpin, status, check, config, config set) validate <kb-id> via cmdutil.ValidateResourceID before --dry-run, exit-10 confirmation, or SDK client construction.
kb delete, kb update, and kb config set enforce exit-10 confirmation before f.Client(), and kb update rejects empty/whitespace-only --name values across --dry-run and live execution.

kb check/status/view/create/pin guard against nil SDK responses, kb check bounds failed-doc pagination and wraps errors via cmdutil.WrapHTTP, and all human text outputs sanitize untrusted server fields.

findings.file: cli/cmd/kb/view.go:50-130, cli/cmd/kb/edit.go:77-180, cli/cmd/kb/delete.go:62-120, cli/cmd/kb/pin.go:57-145, cli/cmd/kb/status.go:64-130, cli/cmd/kb/check.go:67-165, cli/cmd/kb/config.go:42-115, cli/cmd/kb/config_set.go:58-170
findings.summary: kb subcommands lacked ValidateResourceID on <kb-id> (allowing traversal strings into --dry-run, retry_argv, and reachable:false probes), ran f.Client() before confirmation gates, accepted blank --name on kb update, and panicked on nil KB responses in kb check/view/create/pin.

invariants_checked: genyee link validates the resolved profile name via cmdutil.ValidateProfileName and verifies the profile exists in config.Profiles (local.profile_not_found) before writing .genyee/project.yaml.

Resolved KB IDs are validated via cmdutil.ValidateResourceID, interactive KB prompts and text outputs sanitize untrusted KB names/IDs, and genyee unlink safely delegates symlink-guarded removal to projectlink.

findings.summary: genyee link did not validate CurrentProfile syntax or verify profile existence in config.Profiles when --kb was a UUID, allowing --profile <nonexistent> or corrupt config to write an unusable .genyee/project.yaml.

invariants_checked: genyee mcp serve lazily constructs the SDK client on RunE, suppresses stdout log pollution over the JSON-RPC stdio transport, and delegates all 10 tool handlers to cli/internal/mcp.
message delete, message list, and message search validate <message-id> and --session resource IDs via cmdutil.ValidateResourceID before --dry-run, exit-10 confirmation, or SDK client construction.

message delete enforces exit-10 confirmation before f.Client(), message list validates --before RFC3339 timestamps before f.Client(), and message search rejects blank queries, filters nil group items, and sanitizes text table cells.

findings.summary: message subcommands omitted ValidateResourceID on <message-id> and --session, called f.Client() before ConfirmDestructive on delete and before --before parsing on list, and dereferenced nil items in message search.

invariants_checked: --api-key-stdin reads are bounded to 16 KiB and reject embedded CR/LF or control characters with input.invalid_argument across model create and model update.

model view, update, and delete validate <model-id> via ValidateResourceID; model create and update validate --base-url via ValidateHTTPURL and reject negative --dimension; model list validates --type/--source enums before f.Client(); model delete confirms before f.Client().
Provider secrets (api_key, app_secret) in Model.Parameters are scrubbed before emitting JSON or text output across create, update, view, and list.

findings.summary: model create/update read --api-key-stdin with unbounded io.ReadAll and accepted multiline/control characters; model subcommands lacked preflight ID/base-url/dimension/enum checks before dry-run/Client() and did not scrub api_key/app_secret from returned Model.Parameters.

invariants_checked: search chunks validates --vector-threshold and --keyword-threshold for NaN, Inf, and [0, 1] bounds as input.invalid_argument, validates resolved KB IDs, filters nil SearchResult pointers, and strips ANSI/OSC 52 escape sequences in text rendering.
search docs and search sessions validate --page-size before resolving KBs or constructing the SDK client, enforce a 10,000-page safety cap on --all-pages loops, and sanitize human table output.

findings.summary: search chunks accepted NaN/Inf/out-of-range similarity thresholds (failing json.Marshal as retryable network.error) and rendered raw chunk content without nil or OSC 52 guards; search docs/sessions checked --page-size after f.Client() and had unbounded pagination loops.

invariants_checked: session ask, delete, resume, stop, view, and tool-approval resolve validate session/agent/message/pending IDs via cmdutil.ValidateResourceID before --dry-run, NDJSON init emission, exit-10 confirmation, or f.Client().
session delete and session tool-approval resolve enforce exit-10 confirmation before f.Client(); session resume leaves stdout completely empty when rejecting invalid IDs.

session list validates --since before f.Client() and rejects NaNd, Infd, non-positive, and >36500d durations that would overflow time.Duration; session ask guards nil CreateSession responses, caps buffered events/bytes, and surfaces terminal SSE error frames.

findings.file: cli/cmd/session/ask.go:90-290, cli/cmd/session/delete.go:70-155, cli/cmd/session/list.go:92-250, cli/cmd/session/resume.go:97-160, cli/cmd/session/stop.go:60-125, cli/cmd/session/tool_approval.go:90-235, cli/cmd/session/view.go:76-195
findings.summary: session subcommands lacked ValidateResourceID preflight (allowing session resume to write an init frame before failing and destructive gates to run after f.Client()), parseSinceDuration overflowed int64 on large/NaN/Inf <N>d values, and session ask lacked nil-session and terminal-error guards.

invariants_checked: skills install confines embedded relative paths under the target directory, verifies every subdirectory and target file via os.Lstat to reject symlinks (including dangling symlinks without --force and symlinked files with --force), and writes skill files atomically via temp file + 0644 chmod + rename.
resolveDir rejects whitespace-only --dir values, expands ~, ~/, and ~\ prefixes consistently, and initializes installed as an empty slice [] rather than null when all files are skipped.

findings.summary: writeSkills used os.Stat (treating dangling symlinks as non-existent when !force) followed by os.MkdirAll and os.WriteFile, allowing dangling or --force symlinks and symlinked subdirectories to overwrite or create arbitrary files outside --dir.

invariants_checked: Build metadata defaults (Version, Commit, Date) are pure ldflags-overridable string vars with deterministic UserAgent formatting and zero external I/O.

Probe guards against (nil, nil) GetSystemInfo responses without panicking; LoadCache reads server-info.yaml via symlink- and size-guarded xdg.ReadSecureFile (64 KiB cap) and rejects future-dated ProbedAt timestamps as stale.
Compat rejects signed/negative semver segments as unparseable fail-open OK and sanitizes untrusted serverVersion/cliVersion strings before interpolating human hint messages.

findings.summary: compat.Probe panicked on nil SystemInfo responses, LoadCache used unbounded symlink-following os.ReadFile and treated future-dated ProbedAt timestamps as fresh forever, and Compat accepted negative semver numbers and interpolated unsanitized server versions into hints.

invariants_checked: config.Load reads $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/genyee/config.yaml via xdg.ReadSecureFile (1 MiB cap, Lstat symlink/non-regular rejection on parent dir and file, TOCTOU SameFile verification) while preserving zero-value Config on os.ErrNotExist.
config.Save persists YAML atomically with 0600 file permissions and 0700 directory permissions via xdg.WriteAtomicYAML.

findings.summary: config.Load used raw os.ReadFile without symlink checks, regular-file verification, or size bounds, allowing symlinked config.yaml/genyee dirs or named pipes to leak external files or block CLI startup.

invariants_checked: DashIfEmpty strips ANSI/OSC/C0/C1/Bidi terminal control sequences via text.SanitizeInline and returns '-' when an input consists solely of stripped escape codes.
WriteJSON, WriteJSONFiltered (field filters), and writeJQ disable HTML escaping (<, >, &) consistently and terminate JSON lines with '\n'.

findings.summary: DashIfEmpty returned unsanitized strings containing terminal escape sequences to human table renderers, and WriteJSONFiltered/writeJQ used json.Marshal (HTML-escaping <, >, & and omitting trailing newline on field-filtered payloads).

invariants_checked: IOStreams encapsulates In/Out/Err writers and TTY capability flags cleanly with deterministic SetForTest / SetForTestWithTTY test isolation helpers.
toolErrorResult redacts Bearer tokens, gy_* API keys, sk-* provider keys, and URL userinfo credentials from upstream error messages and hints before returning MCP CallToolResult payloads.

chat and session_ask guard against nil/empty CreateSession responses, enforce buffered event/payload caps (4096 events / 4 MiB) in long-lived mcp serve processes, and fail when SSE emits a terminal error frame even if transport returns nil.

doc_list, search_chunks, and chunk_list reject negative page/page_size/limit values, out-of-[0,1] or NaN/Inf similarity thresholds, invalid doc parse statuses, and inverted start_time > end_time windows.

findings.summary: MCP tools leaked raw Bearer/gy_/sk- tokens in error text, panicked on nil CreateSession responses, buffered unbounded SSE events in chat/session_ask, ignored terminal error frames when streamErr==nil, and accepted negative pagination, invalid statuses, and out-of-range thresholds.

invariants_checked: Envelope, BatchResult, and NDJSON stream writers disable HTML escaping, enforce bare-data vs envelope contracts deterministically, and never mutate or execute untrusted strings.

Discover walks at most 64 parent directories and uses os.Lstat on both .genyee and .genyee/project.yaml so symlinked directories, symlinked files, and FIFOs/devices are never treated as project links.
Load uses xdg.ReadSecureFile (64 KiB cap), Save uses symlink-safe 0600 xdg.WriteAtomicYAML, and Remove verifies via os.Lstat that neither .genyee nor project.yaml is a symlink before unlinking.

findings.summary: projectlink.Discover/Load/Remove followed symlinked .genyee directories and project.yaml files (allowing malicious repositories to read or unlink external files on `genyee unlink` or hang on FIFOs).

invariants_checked: TTYPrompter bounds line reads via bufio.Scanner and treats EOF as declined confirmation; AgentPrompter deterministically fails interactive prompts in non-TTY contexts.
TextRenderer runs a stateful streaming ANSI/OSC/DCS/CSI/C0/C1/Bidi sanitizer across chunk boundaries so split OSC 52 clipboard-hijack or title-spoof sequences are stripped completely.
Projector records terminal error frames (TerminalError) alongside lifecycle Done state, and Accumulator / AgentAccumulator bound buffered answer/thinking bytes (16 MiB) and tool events (4096).

findings.summary: sse.TextRenderer wrote raw SSE chunks and reference IDs to terminals without stripping split OSC 52/ANSI escape sequences, Projector discarded terminal error frame state, and Accumulator/AgentAccumulator grew without memory bounds.

invariants_checked: Test-only prompter and XDG temp-dir helpers isolate XDG_CONFIG_HOME / XDG_CACHE_HOME / XDG_DATA_HOME cleanly via t.TempDir() without production side effects.

SanitizeTerminal and SanitizeInline strip CSI, OSC (including OSC 52 payloads), DCS/SOS/PM/APC, 2-byte/nF escapes, C0/DEL/C1 controls, bare CR line-overwrite spoofing, and Unicode Bidi overrides while preserving valid UTF-8 and display-width truncation in Truncate, OneLine, KnowledgeDisplayName, and FuzzyAgoStr.
FuzzyAgo handles timestamps >292 years in the past or future via float64 Unix-second fallback instead of overflowing time.Duration at math.MinInt64/MaxInt64.

findings.file: cli/internal/text/sanitize.go:1-171, cli/internal/text/truncate.go:15-24, cli/internal/text/oneline.go:9-11, cli/internal/text/displayname.go:12-20, cli/internal/text/timeago.go:17-33, cli/internal/text/timeago_string.go:20-28
findings.summary: text helpers lacked ANSI/OSC 52/C1/Bidi terminal sanitization (allowing untrusted server titles, filenames, and unparseable timestamps to inject terminal escapes) and FuzzyAgo overflowed time.Duration for dates >292 years in the future into 'less than a minute from now'.

invariants_checked: xdg.Path ignores relative XDG_* environment variable values per the XDG Base Directory Specification and falls back to $HOME/<fallbackDir>/genyee.

xdg.WriteAtomicYAML rejects symlinked parent directories and symlinked/non-regular target files via os.Lstat, tightens permissive parent directory modes to 0700 on Unix, and writes atomically with mode 0600; xdg.ReadSecureFile enforces Lstat + fstat SameFile + maxBytes bounds.

findings.summary: xdg.Path accepted relative XDG_* paths (violating XDG Base Dir spec and enabling CWD config hijacking), WriteAtomicYAML followed symlinked parent dirs and left permissive parent dir modes unchanged, and xdg lacked a symlink/FIFO/size-guarded ReadSecureFile helper.

invariants_checked: cli/skills/embed.go embeds prompts/* read-only, parses frontmatter deterministically, returns sorted skill/file slices, and passes check-skill-wire-vocab.sh and check-secret-tokens.sh.
